verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no approval or success rate advertised on LegalOS's pages, and no stated basis such as case counts, time windows or methodology. The only figures given are speed claims (48–72 hours to filing readiness) and attorney experience (40+ years), and neither is a success rate. The axis applies to an immigration-services provider, but nothing here shows the product delivers it.

support.subject: As a founder, any advertised approval or success rate comes with a stated basis — case counts, time window, or methodology — on the provider's own pages
